configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: contactId
configurable_props.label: Contact ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the contact associated to the invoice.

configurable_props.name: contactName
configurable_props.label: Contact Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the contact associated to the invoice. If there is no contact matching this name, a new contact is created.

configurable_props.name: lineItems
configurable_props.label: Line Items
configurable_props.description: See [LineItems](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/invoices#LineItemsPOST). The LineItems collection can contain any number of individual LineItem sub-elements. At least * **one** * is required to create a complete Invoice.

configurable_props.name: date
configurable_props.label: Date
configurable_props.description: Date invoice was issued - YYYY-MM-DD. If the Date element is not specified it will default to the current date based on the timezone setting of the organisation.

configurable_props.name: lineAmountType
configurable_props.label: Line Amount Type
configurable_props.description: Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don't specify this element. See [Line Amount Types](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/types#LineAmountTypes)

configurable_props.name: purchaseBillNumber
configurable_props.label: Purchase Bill Number
configurable_props.description: Non-unique alpha numeric code identifying purchase bill (printable ASCII characters only). This value will also display as Reference in the UI.

configurable_props.name: url
configurable_props.label: URL
configurable_props.description: URL link to a source document - shown as "Go to [appName]" in the Xero app

configurable_props.name: currencyCode
configurable_props.label: Currency Code
configurable_props.description: The currency that invoice has been raised in (see [Currencies](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/currencies))

configurable_props.name: currencyRate
configurable_props.label: Currency Rate
configurable_props.description: The currency rate for a multicurrency invoice. If no rate is specified, the [XE.com day rate](http://help.xero.com/#CurrencySettings$Rates) is used. (max length = [18].[6])

configurable_props.name: sentToContact
configurable_props.label: Sent to Contact
configurable_props.description: Boolean to set whether the invoice in the Xero app should be marked as "sent". This can be set only on invoices that have been approved

configurable_props.name: plannedPaymentDate
configurable_props.label: Planned Payment Date
configurable_props.description: Shown on purchase bills (Accounts Payable) when this has been set
